remarks:
Cash flow is king, and 442 18th Street delivers. This income-producing two-family property generates $22,800 in annual rental income and offers an attractive opportunity for investors seeking immediate returns with future upside. With over 2,500 square feet of living space, 8 bedrooms, and 2 full bathrooms across both units, there’s plenty of space to maximize rental potential.

Since the property was first listed, the seller has completed extensive renovations and improvements, making this an even stronger investment opportunity. Recent updates include a new washing machine, new dryer, new oven, and a newly renovated bathroom. The entire exterior has also been freshly painted and stained within the past two months, giving the property excellent curb appeal and reducing immediate maintenance concerns for the next owner.

Outside, tenants will enjoy a fully fenced backyard complete with a deck, adding valuable outdoor living space. Whether you’re expanding your investment portfolio or purchasing your first multifamily property, this is a rare opportunity to own a high-cash-flow asset at an affordable price. The seller has invested significantly in this property since it was originally listed—this is truly a must-see opportunity to appreciate all of the recent improvements.
